Generate a full HTML analysis report for an Olink dataset

Source: R/generate_report.R
generate_report.Rd

Renders a self-contained, styled HTML report (Bootstrap 5 `flatly` theme, floating table of contents, KPI summary cards, interactive `DT` tables, and publication-ready figures) covering QC, normality, ordination, variance partitioning, differential expression, ROC curves, longitudinal LMM screening, and pathway/STRING network analysis.

Usage

generate_report(
  data,
  output_file = "olink_report.html",
  output_dir = getwd(),
  title = "Olink Proteomics Analysis Report",
  subtitle = "Automated QC, Differential Expression, Longitudinal & Pathway Report",
  author = "OlinkViz",
  group = NULL,
  time = NULL,
  subject_id = NULL,
  plate_col = NULL,
  covariates = NULL,
  covariate_interaction = FALSE,
  include_network = TRUE,
  open = interactive()
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame (long format), an OlinkExperiment, or a file path (`.csv`, `.tsv`, `.rds`, `.xlsx`, `.xls`).

output_file

Output HTML file name (default `"olink_report.html"`).

output_dir

Output directory (default `getwd()`).

title

Report title.

subtitle

Report subtitle.

author

Report author.

group

Optional grouping column name (auto-detected if `NULL`).

time

Optional timepoint column name (auto-detected if `NULL`).

subject_id

Optional subject ID column name (auto-detected if `NULL`).

plate_col

Optional plate/batch column name (auto-detected if `NULL`).

covariates

Optional character vector of covariate column names (e.g. `c("age", "BMI", "sex")`) for mixed-model adjustment.

covariate_interaction

Logical or character vector of covariates that interact with `time` in the mixed model (default `FALSE`).

include_network

Logical; include pathway enrichment and STRING protein-protein interaction networks (default `TRUE`).

open

Logical; open the rendered HTML report in the default browser (default `interactive()`).

Value

The path to the generated HTML report (invisibly).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
generate_report(probc, output_file = "probc_report.html")
} # }
